page_note: 该页上半部为OECD《Economic Outlook Interim Report March 2025》的Figure 11分组柱状图（2007Q4与2024Q3各国政府总债务占GDP比重，日本单列并使用右侧不同刻度轴），下半部为第33段正文。

figures.source_line: Source: Eurostat; IMF Sovereign Debt Investor Base database; OECD Economic Outlook 116 database; Office for National Statistics; and OECD calculations.

components.evidence: two bars, green and orange, side by side in each country slot such as TUR, IDN, MEX
the '2007Q4' / '2024Q3 or latest available' key boxes are drawn over the plot area near the top
category axis reads TUR IDN MEX KOR AUS DEU ZAF IND CHN BRA GBR ESP CAN ARG FRA USA ITA JPN
thin horizontal rules at 30, 60, 90, 120 across the panel, no vertical grid
'% of GDP' printed above the 150 tick on the left and above the 250 tick on the right
bare ticks 0-150 and 0-250; scale word only in '% of GDP' above the axes
'Note: The chart shows general government financial liabilities...' and 'Source: Eurostat; IMF Sovereign Debt Investor Base database; ...'

new_components.name: secondary_scale_for_one_category
new_components.evidence: JPN sits right of a vertical rule and is read on the right axis 0-250 while the others use left 0-150
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一单位（% of GDP）却有两套刻度：若把JPN的柱按左轴读，2024Q3会得到约135而非225，读数会整体偏低约40%。

new_components.name: vertical_panel_divider
new_components.evidence: a thick black vertical rule between ITA and JPN splitting the plot area into two zones
new_components.why_it_matters: 这条竖线是判定某柱该用左轴还是右轴的唯一线索，缺失时无法确定JPN两根柱的量级。

new_components.name: duplicated_axis_title_both_sides
new_components.evidence: '% of GDP' appears twice, once above the left axis and once above the right axis
new_components.why_it_matters: 两侧单位文字相同，容易让人误以为两轴同刻度，需靠刻度数字自行区分。

difficulty_notes: 柱上完全没有数值标注，全部10个目标值都要靠像素对刻度反推。左轴刻度间隔为30个百分点（约57px），TUR的27在5%容差下只允许±1.35pp，即约±2.5px，必须做亚刻度插值；CHN 88与BRA 87相差仅1pp（不到2px），二者的行几乎无法区分。更棘手的是JPN被竖线隔开后改用右轴（间隔50），225与152若误按左轴读只有约135与91，误差超过40%，远超容差；因此“读数”而非“标签”是主要障碍——寻址只需国家代码+图例名两个键。
